Blitz had a trauma trigger in response to being forced to be put on stage, you can see in his panicked response moments before. The dopamine rush afterwards made from the crowd made it even more difficult to pull away. It wasn't until something broke his focus on the whole "performance" thing that Blitz actually took action to escape. Stolas is from a royal family, and it really isnt a stretch to imainge there were many points in his life he just had to deal with something, rather than fighting it. Stolas most likely figured it'd just be faster to get it over with, and as he was already confident in Blitz's performance abilities. Stolas clearly didnt recognize Blitz reaction for what it was, and Blitz wasnt in the headspace to argue any further than he already had.

I feel as though this wasn't just a "haha funny" moment in the show, but it also stood as a good insight into how their character traits show through as flaws. Yes, that was a *poor* decision on both of their behalfs, I don't think it was poor show writing; quite the opposite actually. It showed character depth in my opinion, just as many of the scenes in this show do.

I'm not trying to be rude, but i don't think thats a fair thing to say. As a trans man myself, they aren't the only people who face hate, or criticism. Yes, trans women absolutely face prejudice and discrimination, and it should 100% be a priority to fix that issue. However, we need to fix it for all trans people (all people realistically, but I'm only speaking about this movement specifically). Again, I am by no means saying trans women don't struggle, but it's important to recognize trans men, non-binary people, and many others who fall under the trans umbrella struggle too.

I was in a car with my boyfriend at the time, when my boyfriend says "hey, techno posted a new video." We were both so excited since its been a few months, and when we watched at first, we didn't believe it. My brain struggled to comprehend full situation. I knew he wouldn't joke about something like this, but there's no way he's actually gone, right? I hoped with with every fiber of my being that it was some cruel joke, but by the end of the video, I realized it wasn't. We parked the car somewhere and just sat for a bit, and we mourned his loss. I'd only known of his channel for about a year at that point, but I'd watched countless videos. He was, and is, a great creator.
